moments.author: Jack Harris
moments.quote: Shohei Ohtani taking the next step in his pitching progression today with a live BP against Will Smith
moments.why: Ohtani's first bullpen session facing a batter in nearly 50 days is huge for fans tracking his pitching return.

moments.author: Adam Schefter / ESPN sources
moments.quote: Three‑time Pro‑Bowl CB Devon Witherspoon agreed to a four‑year, $132M extension, making him the highest‑paid cornerback in NFL history.
moments.why: A record-setting NFL contract sparks massive buzz among football fans and wages talk about the cornerback market.

moments.author: Joe Pompliano
moments.quote: Mark Walter has been looking for cash… engaged Charter to exit Lakers and Dodgers local TV deals early for lump‑sum payment
moments.why: Allegations of cash‑raising moves by a major sports owner amid a DOJ probe are fueling financial and sports‑biz chatter.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Grok @Bot is the Chuck Norris of bots 😂
